platform.h1: From document to a record someone can stand behind.
platform.lead: Most of the work is predictable: reading a file, checking it against a rule, and preparing the evidence. enterlabs takes on that work. People stay with the exceptions, and every finding keeps its source beside it.
platform.intro: The screens below follow a supplier invoice checked against a purchase order and a delivery note. The same sequence applies wherever a team has to read, check and hand on a document.

trust.title: Trust and security | enterlabs
trust.description: Review enterlabs security practices, certification, data handling and deployment considerations with your IT and security teams.
trust.lead: Explore our controls, privacy practices and deployment options with your IT and security teams.
trust.compliance_lead: Explore supporting information in our trust center and the Security Overview, then discuss the requirements of your deployment.
trust.deploy_lead: Follow the document data. Agree the requirements at every stage.

deploy_items.p: Confirm where documents are stored and processed, who holds them and what retention and deletion requirements apply.

Choose a fully managed cloud or scope a hybrid in-tenant deployment. In the hybrid model, document processing and personal-data redaction run within the client environment before redacted data reaches the enterlabs cloud.
Role-based access follows least privilege. Authentication requirements are configured for the applicable accounts. Define analyst, quality-review and administration responsibilities for the workflow.
The platform supports your existing team. Your reviewers inspect the outputs and remain responsible for the final decision.

trust.diligence_lead: Review the evidence, clarify ownership and agree acceptance criteria.

diligence_questions.p: Discuss the security documentation and control evidence needed to evaluate the proposed deployment.
diligence_questions.agree: Requested evidence, applicable scope and the person responsible for supplying it.

diligence_questions.p: Clarify who owns document handling, reference data, integrations and human correction.
diligence_questions.agree: Responsibilities to carry into the implementation plan and contracting discussion.

diligence_questions.p: Choose representative documents, expected test results and acceptance criteria for the actual workflow.
diligence_questions.agree: The test scope, expected-results owner and criteria for moving forward.

diligence_questions.p: Confirm which corrections and review actions need to be retained for quality checks and follow-up.
diligence_questions.agree: The reporting and record requirements of your operating process.

controls.p: Encryption measures include application-level AES-GCM encryption. Development, staging and production environments are separated.

Personal-data redaction happens before LLM processing. Redacted personal data is treated as personal data, with processing locations and transfers addressed in the agreed deployment and data-processing terms.
Authentication, data access and administrative actions are logged. Reviewers can trace AI outputs to source documents and the relevant rule or reference.

The customer remains the data controller. Processing terms, retention, deletion and applicable sub-processors are addressed in the client data-processing agreement and maintained sub-processor register.
